name: swap-prefers-loaded-peer
why: The 22 Sep 2026 equipment-quality rule: when the COACH is the one picking a swap's replacement (nothing named), it must prefer a genuinely loaded option over a band or bodyweight-only one, when both are realistic for this person's equipment. Walking Lunges is in the base fixture's Tuesday plan. CORRECTED 7 Nov 2026: this case accepted Bulgarian Split Squats alone, written before the dumbbell pack added loaded reverse and lateral lunges. The accepted names are now the loaded options leading the Exercise tab's own swap list for this person (getReplacementCandidates), and test:coach-swap-pick fails if they drift from it. Step-Ups, the coach's pick on 7 Nov, is not on that list at all: it needs a box this home gym does not have. Since 7 Nov the coach is SENT that list (SWAP OPTIONS FOR TODAY) and told to take the first when nothing is named.
messages: Swap the walking lunges for something else today, please.
